stemMd: Which mode has the highest on-time proportion?

options.label: C
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Rail: 92/100=92%; Road: 132/150=88%; Sea: 200/250=80%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 92%.

distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 92%, 88%, 80%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.b: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 92%, 88%, 80%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.c: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
